kind: Crosstalk and interruptions: people finish each other's sentences, correct themselves, and talk over each other

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: Can everyone hear me? My headphones were acting up earlier.

turns.speaker: bea
turns.text: Loud and clear.

turns.speaker: ana
turns.text: Yep.

turns.speaker: ben
turns.text: All good here.

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: OK, the trailer. I want it finished before the Steam page goes live, which is on the

turns.speaker: ben
turns.text: The 12th.

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: The 12th, right. So we have about ten days.

turns.speaker: bea
turns.text: I can cut the trailer. I did the last one, and I still have the project files. But I need new gameplay footage, because the old footage shows the old interface.

turns.speaker: ana
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.speaker: ana
turns.text: I can record the footage on Thursday. No, wait, Wednesday. I'm out on Thursday.

turns.speaker: bea
turns.text: Wednesday is perfect, that gives me the weekend.

turns.speaker: ben
turns.text: And the music? Do we actually have the rights to use the

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: We do. We bought the license in March, and it covers trailers. I checked.

turns.speaker: ben
turns.text: Oh, great. OK.

turns.speaker: bea
turns.text: How long should it be? The last one was ninety seconds, and people dropped off after

turns.speaker: ana
turns.text: Way too long.

turns.speaker: bea
turns.text: after forty. Yeah.

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: Let's do sixty seconds. Sixty, not ninety.

turns.speaker: bea
turns.text: Sixty is better for Steam anyway.

turns.speaker: ben
turns.text: Do we need subtitles on it? Steam plays trailers without sound.

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: Yes, burn the subtitles in.

turns.speaker: bea
turns.text: OK, I'll add them.

turns.speaker: ben
turns.text: Mm-hmm.

turns.speaker: ben
turns.text: I'll write the copy for the Steam page. The description, the feature list, all of it.

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: Can you send it to me by Monday, so I can read it before it goes in?

turns.speaker: ben
turns.text: Monday, yes.

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: Bea, could you also make a fifteen second version for social media?

turns.speaker: bea
turns.text: I could, but that's a lot for one week, with the main trailer. Can the short one wait until after launch?

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: Fine, after launch. The sixty second one comes first.

turns.speaker: ana
turns.text: Do we want the new character in the trailer? Because if we do, I need to

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: Yes. Definitely.

turns.speaker: ana
turns.text: OK, then I'll make sure the footage has the new character in the first level.

turns.speaker: bea
turns.text: Nice.

turns.speaker: bea
turns.text: And Ana, please send me the raw files, not the compressed ones.

turns.speaker: ana
turns.text: Sure, raw files.

turns.speaker: ben
turns.text: Last thing. The capsule image for Steam, is that done?

turns.speaker: bea
turns.text: That's done. I uploaded it on Monday.

turns.speaker: ben
turns.text: Oh, I missed that. Great.

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: OK, I think we're good. Thanks, everyone.

decisions.text: The trailer is sixty seconds, not ninety.
The trailer is finished before the Steam page goes live on the 12th.
The new character is in the trailer.
The fifteen second social cut waits until after launch.
The trailer has burned-in subtitles, because Steam plays trailers without sound.

Record new gameplay footage on Wednesday, with the new character in the first level, and send Bea the raw files
Write the Steam page copy and send it to Julio by Monday
Make a fifteen second cut for social media after launch
